About

From research
to the room
where it happens.

I help organizations navigate policy, government, and public opinion — the three forces that decide how an issue really plays out.

I began at the Hankyoreh Social Policy Institute as a researcher, convinced that rigorous analysis could move policy in the right direction. That conviction took me into the Office of the President (Blue House), where I watched — and helped shape — how policy actually changes and how social progress is driven.

Since then, in global public-affairs advisory, I have counseled major companies on government relations, regulatory positioning, and high-stakes issues, writing the policy- and political-landscape analyses that guide leadership decisions. I work fluently across English and Korean — and just as fluently between the analysis and the argument.

Policy Research & Analysis
From think-tank social-policy research to client-facing analyses of the political and regulatory landscape — evidence-led, decision-ready.
Government & Stakeholder Relations
Relationships built inside government, and the experience to align agencies, industry, and outside partners around a single position.
Strategic & Crisis Communications
Submissions, briefings, op-eds, and spokesperson work that make a technical or political story land with any audience — and hold steady when it turns sensitive.
Bilingual, Global Coordination
Native-level English and Korean — comfortable representing Korean positions to global counterparts and vice versa across time zones.
What I believe

I started out believing that good policy and honest communication can change things for the public good. That belief still shapes how I work — evidence first, people always.

My career sits at the intersection of evidence and persuasion — research that holds up, and communication that moves the people who matter. Whether the work is government relations, a sensitive issue, or a crisis breaking in real time, the discipline is the same: get the facts right, find the human stakes, and make the complex clear.

Change is possible
My career is built on the belief that good work moves things forward.
Act on evidence
Research-trained; I let analysis, not assumption, lead the argument.
Share knowledge
Translating complex issues into clear, accessible language is my craft.
Everyone at the table
Coalition-building across government, industry, and civil society.

Autonomous, detail-oriented, and composed when it counts.

How I Work

Quality work,
fast turnaround

I'm technically adventurous — never afraid to learn and put new technology to work to streamline how things get done. In communications and public affairs, the brief is almost always "excellent, and by tomorrow." The right tools are how I hit both.

How that shows up
01
New tools, quickly
I adopt and learn new software and AI tooling fast, then fold it into real work — research, monitoring, drafting — so output stays sharp on tight deadlines.
02
Automate the repetitive
Media monitoring, first-draft synthesis, translation passes, landscape scans — I build workflows that take the grind out so judgment gets the time.
03
Quality, never traded
Speed only counts if the work holds up. Technology accelerates the draft; the facts, framing, and final polish stay rigorously human.
04
Built to run remote
Self-directed in distributed teams. I set up the systems, docs, and cadence that keep people in sync without a manager in the room.
